notable.grandline.corvel.title: Lord Treasurer of Ilisia
dialogue.grandline.notable.corvel: I am extremely busy, and you are extremely unimportant. Good day.
notable.grandline.brinicle.title: "the Ice Thief", Captain of the Slush Pirates
dialogue.grandline.notable.brinicle: Cold enough for you? It will be. Everything in the South Blue gets cold eventually. I just charge for it.
arc.grandline.scrap_baron.why: Fuyugane's whalers can't hunt without their harpoon guns, and the guns were sold to the Scrap Baron of Spider Miles — who is bolting every gun in the North Blue onto gunboats to raid the kingdom of Lvneel.
arc.grandline.scrap_baron.cast.solveig: 'Frostbite', the North Ember. The Saltfire King's old gunner: deaf in one ear, loud in both.
arc.grandline.scrap_baron.cast.nell: 'Sprocket', a junk-picker who knows every heap on Spider Miles and every one of the Baron's secrets.
arc.grandline.scrap_baron.cast.haakon: King of Lvneel, a kingdom of explorers who sailed off the edge of the map and came back.
arc.grandline.scrap_baron.cast.rusty: 'the Scrap Baron', lord of the junk fortress. Everything washes up on Spider Miles eventually; he keeps the guns.
arc.grandline.decision.north_plan: what to save first at Spider Miles (talk to Nell)
arc.grandline.site.fuyugane_raiders: the harpoon thieves' camp in Fuyugane's snow
quest.grandline.north_nell.desc: Somebody is hissing at you from under a boiler. Talk to Nell, the junk-picker of Spider Miles.
quest.grandline.north_yard.desc: Get into the Scrap Baron's gun yard: beat 4 of his guards.
quest.grandline.north_choice.desc: The gunboats launch at dawn, and the pickers who built them are penned at the far end of the yard. Talk to Nell and decide what to save first.
quest.grandline.north_spike.desc: Spike the gunboats before they launch: beat 3 of the slipway crew.
quest.grandline.north_pens.desc: Free the press-ganged pickers: beat 3 of the guards who carry the keys.
scene.grandline.ember_north_1.start.1: solveig|WHAT? Speak into the good ear! ...Ha! Thirty years of cannon fire will do that. You're the one with the horizon in your eyes, eh?
scene.grandline.ember_north_1.start.2: solveig|I was the Saltfire King's gunner. Now I'm an old woman on a cold rock, and the cold rock has a problem.
scene.grandline.ember_north_1.start.3: solveig|Bandits broke into the whalers' shed and took every harpoon gun on the island. No harpoons, no whales. No whales, no winter. You see?
scene.grandline.ember_north_1.start.4: solveig|Get after them. And I want to see you FIGHT, not flail: land a blow, guard one, dodge one, show me a technique. Ask me for a practice bout first if you're nervous. I'll shout encouragement. Loudly.
scene.grandline.ember_north_1.talk.1: solveig|WHAT? Oh, it's you. The bandits went up into the snow. Go on! Or do you want a practice bout first? I don't bite. Much.
scene.grandline.ember_north_1.end.1: solveig|HA! You've got a gunner's temper. Good!
scene.grandline.ember_north_1.end.2: narrator|The bandits' sledges are empty. Only a bill of sale is left, frozen to a crate: TWELVE HARPOON GUNS — SOLD TO R. KUZUTETSU, SPIDER MILES.
scene.grandline.ember_north_1.end.3: solveig|Rusty Kuzutetsu. The Scrap Baron. He buys every gun in the North Blue and never says what for.
scene.grandline.ember_north_1.end.4: solveig|Go to Spider Miles. Get our guns back, and find out what that rust-bucket is planning. Take my old chart. I'd come, but the ice would miss me.
scene.grandline.ember_north_2.start.1: solveig|Spider Miles is east. Follow the smoke. Everything there is junk, including the people — except one or two. Find the one or two.
scene.grandline.ember_north_2.end.1: narrator|Spider Miles: a fortress built out of shipwrecks, bristling with rusted cannon. The smoke never stops. Somewhere inside, a hammer rings on iron, again and again.
scene.grandline.north_nell.start.1: nell|Pssst. Down here. Under the boiler. No, the OTHER boiler.
scene.grandline.north_nell.end.1: nell|Nell. Junk-picker. I find things. Today I found you, so that's a good day.
scene.grandline.north_nell.end.2: nell|Your harpoon guns? Bolted onto gunboats, every one. The Baron's built six of them in the yard. He's going to sail them into Lvneel's harbour and take the kingdom's treasury.
scene.grandline.north_nell.end.3: nell|And the pickers who built them — my friends — he keeps in the pens behind the yard. Work, sleep, work. Nobody leaves Spider Miles.
scene.grandline.north_nell.end.4: nell|The gun yard's guarded. Get in there and you'll see it for yourself.
scene.grandline.north_yard.end.1: narrator|Six gunboats on the slipway, harpoon guns bristling along their rails. Behind the yard, in a pen of welded hull-plate, thirty pickers watch you through the bars.
scene.grandline.north_yard.end.2: nell|There they are. All of them. And the boats launch at dawn.
scene.grandline.north_choice.talk.1: nell|We can't do both before dawn. The slipway's at one end of the yard, the pens at the other, and the Baron's guards are in between.
scene.grandline.north_choice.talk.2: nell|Spike the gunboats and they never sail. Lvneel stays safe, and its king pays well for news like that. But my friends stay in the pens until the Baron's beaten. If he's beaten.
scene.grandline.north_choice.talk.3: nell|Or open the pens. Thirty angry pickers with wrenches will fight beside you, I promise you that. But the gunboats launch, and Lvneel's harbour burns a little before anyone stops them.
scene.grandline.north_choice.talk.4: narrator|Somewhere far behind you, an old gunner's voice: find the one or two.
scene.grandline.choice.north_plan.gunboa: Spike the gunboats. Lvneel must not burn.
scene.grandline.choice.north_plan.picker: Open the pens. Thirty people come first.
scene.grandline.north_choice.end.gunboat: nell|...All right. The slipway's at the north end. I'll show you where they keep the sand.
scene.grandline.north_choice.end.pickers: nell|Thank you. Thank you. The pen keys are on the guards' belts — the big guards, of course. It's always the big ones.
scene.grandline.north_spike.end.1: narrator|One by one, the gunboats' harpoon guns go silent, their breeches packed with sand. Six boats that will never leave the slipway.
scene.grandline.north_pens.end.1: narrator|The pen gate swings open. Thirty pickers pour out with wrenches, pipes and very long memories. Out in the bay, six gunboats slide off the slipway and turn west, towards Lvneel.
rusty|Everything washes up on Spider Miles eventually. Ships, guns, idiots. You're the third kind. Welcome to the scrap heap!
rusty|My boats! My beautiful boats! Full of SAND!
rusty|Everything washes up on Spider Miles eventually. You'll wash up in pieces.
rusty|My workers! Who opened my PENS?
scene.grandline.north_scrap_baron.end.1: narrator|The Scrap Baron goes down in a heap of his own junk.
scene.grandline.north_scrap_baron.end.gu: narrator|The Scrap Baron goes down in a heap of his own junk. In the pens, thirty pickers start banging on the bars — not in fear now. In applause.
nell|I'll get the keys. You go and tell that king his treasury's safe.
scene.grandline.north_scrap_baron.end.pi: narrator|The Scrap Baron goes down under a pile of pickers and their wrenches. Far to the west, smoke rises over Lvneel's harbour.
nell|We did this. Now go and tell the king — and tell him it was worth it. Make him believe it.
scene.grandline.north_lvneel_passage.end: haakon|The Scrap Baron is finished? Then Lvneel owes you. Take this Log Pose — the Twin Capes await, at the foot of Reverse Mountain.
haakon|The Scrap Baron's gunboats, full of sand? Ha! Lvneel was built by explorers, and explorers know a good story. Here — the treasury you saved can spare a little.
haakon|And a Log Pose. Every explorer of Lvneel sails for the Grand Line in the end. The Twin Capes lie south-east, at the foot of Reverse Mountain.
haakon|Six gunboats in my harbour, and we put them out with buckets. I won't pretend I'm happy.
haakon|But thirty people are free on Spider Miles, and that... that is the kind of trade an explorer's king should be proud of. Lvneel will remember the debt either way.
haakon|Take this Log Pose. The Twin Capes lie south-east, at the foot of Reverse Mountain.
recap.grandline.ember_north_1: Chased the harpoon thieves through Fuyugane's snow while Grandma Sólveig taught you to fight.
recap.grandline.ember_north_2: Found the bill of sale — the whalers' guns went to the Scrap Baron — and sailed to Spider Miles.
recap.grandline.north_nell: Met Nell the junk-picker: the guns are bolted to gunboats bound for Lvneel, and the pickers who built them are penned.
recap.grandline.north_yard: Broke into the gun yard and saw the gunboats and the pens for yourself.
recap.grandline.north_choice.gunboats: Decided to spike the gunboats first.
recap.grandline.north_choice.pickers: Decided to open the pens first.
recap.grandline.north_spike: Packed the gunboats' guns with sand.
recap.grandline.north_pens: Opened the pens; thirty pickers came out swinging — and the gunboats sailed for Lvneel.
recap.grandline.north_scrap_baron.gunboa: Toppled the Scrap Baron; his gunboats never left the slipway.
recap.grandline.north_scrap_baron.picker: Toppled the Scrap Baron with thirty pickers at your back.
recap.grandline.north_lvneel_passage: Told King Haakon the Scrap Baron is finished, and set course for the Twin Capes.
arc.grandline.scrap_baron.bonus.gunboats: King Haakon pays you 3,000 Beli from the treasury you saved, and Lvneel's door is always open to you.
arc.grandline.scrap_baron.bonus.pickers: The freed pickers give you the best thing they ever salvaged: a slingshot that never misses, and a sack of shot.
arc.grandline.scrap_baron.aid.pickers: Thirty pickers with wrenches crowd round the fight. Blows meant for you keep landing on scrap metal.
arc.grandline.scrap_baron.after.solveig: WHAT? The harpoons are back? HA! The whalers sang all the way out of the harbour. Terrible voices. Wonderful noise.
arc.grandline.scrap_baron.after.nell: Spider Miles is quieter without the Baron. Quieter is good.
arc.grandline.scrap_baron.after.nell.gun: You picked the boats over us. I understand it. I'll understand it better in a year or two.
arc.grandline.scrap_baron.after.nell.pic: Thirty people free and a king who's cross with you. Best trade I ever saw.
arc.grandline.scrap_baron.after.haakon.g: The hero of the sandy gunboats! Lvneel's door is always open.
arc.grandline.scrap_baron.after.haakon.p: You cost my harbour a pier and bought thirty lives. I'm still doing the sums. They come out in your favour.
arc.grandline.scrap_baron.after.townsfol: The harpoons are back and the whalers are out! There'll be oil for the lamps this winter after all.
The Scrap Baron's finished! Lvneel sleeps easy.
They say the Scrap Baron's boats are rotting on his slipway, full of sand! Sing it again!
Those gunboats burned half the east pier. But the King says it was worth it, and he was there.
arc.grandline.swallow_crown.why: Brigands on Ilisia's royal road raid Kirinoha Isle's wool caravans. The brigands wear royal guards' boots — and the queen's treasury, it turns out, has been empty for a year.
arc.grandline.swallow_crown.cast.perciva: 'Gust', the West Ember. The Saltfire King's old helmsman, who still reads the wind like a letter.
arc.grandline.swallow_crown.cast.kagerou: master of the Swallow's Dojo in Kano Country. Teaches you to ride the wind instead of fighting it.
arc.grandline.swallow_crown.cast.isadora: Queen of Ilisia. Generous, poetic, and badly served by her own treasury.
arc.grandline.swallow_crown.cast.corvel: Lord Treasurer of Ilisia. Emptied the treasury, stopped paying the guards, and hired real cut-throats so the robberies would be blamed on them.
arc.grandline.decision.west_plan: what becomes of the deserters (talk to Queen Isadora)
arc.grandline.site.ilisia_cutthroats: the cut-throats at the treasurer's manor gates
quest.grandline.west_road.desc: Brigands haunt Ilisia's royal road. Reach the kingdom and beat 5 of them.
quest.grandline.west_choice.desc: The deserters were starving, and the treasurer has fled with the treasury. Talk to Queen Isadora and decide what becomes of the deserters.
quest.grandline.west_pardon.desc: Tell the guards they're pardoned: talk to 2 of them (or their families in town).
quest.grandline.west_court.desc: The treasurer's hired cut-throats guard his manor. Beat 3 of them at the gates.
quest.grandline.west_corvel.desc: Lord Treasurer Corvel Haraguro is holed up in his manor with Ilisia's treasury. Defeat him.
quest.grandline.west_knighted.desc: The treasurer has fallen. Return to Queen Isadora.
scene.grandline.ember_west_1.start.1: percival|Feel that? The wind's turning west to east. It does that when someone's about to leave home.
scene.grandline.ember_west_1.start.2: percival|Percival. I held the Saltfire King's helm, once. Now I read the wind for a village of sheep farmers, and the wind says: brigands.
scene.grandline.ember_west_1.start.3: percival|They came over from the royal road and took the wool caravan. The whole season's shearing. Kirinoha can't buy grain without it.
scene.grandline.ember_west_1.start.4: percival|Go and get it back. Fight like the wind, not like a wall: land a blow, guard one, slip one, and show me a technique. Ask me for a practice bout first if you'd like to warm up.
scene.grandline.ember_west_1.talk.1: percival|The brigands went up the valley. Or would you like a bout first? The wind says you would.
scene.grandline.ember_west_1.end.1: percival|There. You rode that fight instead of fighting it. Mostly.
scene.grandline.ember_west_1.end.2: narrator|One of the fallen brigands wears good boots — royal issue, stamped with Ilisia's crown, the soles worn right through.
scene.grandline.ember_west_1.end.3: percival|Royal guard's boots on a brigand. The wind doesn't like that, and neither do I.
scene.grandline.ember_west_1.end.4: percival|Before you go near a queen's road, see Master Kagerou in Kano Country — he'll teach you what I can't. Take my chart. Then go and ask Ilisia why its guards are robbing sheep farmers.
scene.grandline.ember_west_2.start.1: percival|Kano Country is east, up the terraces. Kagerou will try to knock you off them. Let him. That's the lesson.
scene.grandline.ember_west_2.end.1: narrator|Kano Country climbs its hills in green terraces, and at the top, among the swallows' nests, stands the Swallow's Dojo.
scene.grandline.west_kano_trial.start.1: kagerou|A swallow does not fight the wind. It rides it. Your stance fights everything, including the floor.
scene.grandline.west_kano_trial.start.2: kagerou|Spar with me. When I stop knocking you down, you may go.
scene.grandline.west_kano_trial.end.1: kagerou|...Enough. You stopped fighting the wind. Take this scroll: one sword, one breath, one cut.
scene.grandline.west_kano_trial.end.2: kagerou|You asked about the royal road. Half my students came from Ilisia's guard — good boys, poor boys. Last year they stopped writing home. Find out why.
scene.grandline.west_road.end.1: narrator|The last brigand drops his sword and doesn't reach for it again. Under the mud, his coat is royal blue.
scene.grandline.west_road.end.2: deserter|Please. We're the queen's guard. We haven't been paid in a year. The treasurer says the treasury's empty. We were STARVING.
scene.grandline.west_road.end.3: deserter|The ones who burned the caravans weren't us. They're real cut-throats. The treasurer hired them, so the robberies would be blamed on deserters. On us.
scene.grandline.west_ilisia_audience.end: isadora|Ilisia welcomes travellers, poets, and anyone brave enough to clear the royal road. Which of — ...you've brought one of my guards. In chains.
isadora|Unpaid? For a YEAR? Lord Corvel told me the treasury was full. He showed me the books every month. Beautiful books. Gold leaf in the margins.
corvel|Your Majesty, this is slander, from a deserter and a — a foreigner. I am shocked. Shocked and, frankly, busy.
narrator|Lord Treasurer Corvel bows, backs out of the throne room, and does not come back.
scene.grandline.west_choice.talk.1: isadora|My treasurer has fled to his manor with my treasury, and my guards became brigands because I didn't notice. What a queen I've been.
scene.grandline.west_choice.talk.2: isadora|The law says a deserter hangs. The law also says a soldier is paid. The crown broke the law first.
scene.grandline.west_choice.talk.3: isadora|I could pardon them. They'd go with you to the treasurer's manor and fight for their own name, and they'd guard the road again tomorrow.
scene.grandline.west_choice.talk.4: isadora|Or I hold a proper court — the deserters and the treasurer, the same day, under the same law. It will be just. It will be slow. And until it's done, the road has no guard at all.
scene.grandline.west_choice.talk.5: isadora|You found them. You found him. You decide, and I will sign it.
scene.grandline.choice.west_plan.pardon: Pardon them. They were starving, not wicked — let them help bring the treasurer in.
scene.grandline.choice.west_plan.court: Hold the court. The same law for the deserters and the treasurer.
scene.grandline.west_choice.end.pardon.1: isadora|Then by my hand they are pardoned. Go and tell them yourself — they'll want to hear it from you.
scene.grandline.west_choice.end.court.1: isadora|Then the court sits tomorrow. Until then, the treasurer's cut-throats are guarding his manor. Someone will have to deal with them.
scene.grandline.west_pardon.end.1: narrator|Two dozen thin men in royal blue stand up very straight when you tell them. One of them cries. Then they reach for their swords.
scene.grandline.west_court.end.1: narrator|The last of the treasurer's cut-throats goes down outside the manor gates. Inside, someone is shouting at a clerk to burn the books faster.
scene.grandline.west_corvel.start.1: corvel|You can't touch me. I am the Lord Treasurer of Ilisia.
scene.grandline.west_corvel.start.pardon: corvel|Guards! Seize — oh. Oh, those ARE the guards.
deserter|Evening, my lord. We've come about our wages.
corvel|You can't touch me! I have documents! I have WAX SEALS!
scene.grandline.west_corvel.end.1: narrator|Lord Corvel goes down among his gold-leafed ledgers.
scene.grandline.west_corvel.end.pardon.1: narrator|Lord Corvel goes down among his gold-leafed ledgers. The pardoned guards carry the treasury chests out into the sun one by one, and nobody keeps a coin.
scene.grandline.west_corvel.end.court.1: narrator|Lord Corvel goes down among his gold-leafed ledgers. Tomorrow he will stand before the court beside the men he starved, under the same law.
scene.grandline.west_knighted.end.1: isadora|Ilisia is grateful. Take this Log Pose — the Twin Capes lie east, at the foot of Reverse Mountain.
scene.grandline.west_knighted.end.pardon: isadora|Kneel. ...No? Fine, stand. Ilisia is grateful. The road is guarded again by men who know what a year without pay feels like, and the merchants say they'll remember who brought it about.
isadora|Percival's letter said you'd go far. Take this Log Pose — the Twin Capes lie east, at the foot of Reverse Mountain.
isadora|Kneel. ...No? Fine, stand. By the sword and the same law for all, you are a Knight of the Ilisian Road. It is mostly ceremonial. The sword is real.
isadora|The road goes unguarded until the court is done, I'm afraid. Justice is slow. Take this Log Pose — the Twin Capes lie east, at the foot of Reverse Mountain.
recap.grandline.ember_west_1: Took Kirinoha's wool caravan back from brigands in royal boots, while Uncle Percival taught you to fight.
recap.grandline.ember_west_2: Sailed for Kano Country to learn from Master Kagerou.
recap.grandline.west_kano_trial: Passed the Swallow's Trial: you stopped fighting the wind.
recap.grandline.west_road: Cleared the royal road and found the brigands were the queen's own unpaid guards.
recap.grandline.west_ilisia_audience: Told Queen Isadora; her Lord Treasurer fled with the treasury.
recap.grandline.west_choice.pardon: Decided the deserters should be pardoned.
recap.grandline.west_choice.court: Decided everyone would face the royal court under the same law.
recap.grandline.west_pardon: Told the pardoned guards; they took up their swords again.
recap.grandline.west_court: Broke the treasurer's hired cut-throats at his manor gates.
recap.grandline.west_corvel.pardon: Brought down the Lord Treasurer with the pardoned guards behind you; the treasury went back to the crown.
recap.grandline.west_corvel.court: Brought down the Lord Treasurer; he will face the court beside the men he starved.
recap.grandline.west_knighted: Received the queen's thanks — and a Log Pose for the Twin Capes.
arc.grandline.swallow_crown.bonus.court: Queen Isadora makes you a Knight of the Ilisian Road. The sword is real: a fine cutlass with the crown on its guard.
arc.grandline.swallow_crown.bonus.pardon: The pardoned guards hold the royal road again. Ilisia's shops give you 15% off from now on.
arc.grandline.swallow_crown.aid.pardon: Two dozen guards in royal blue fall in around you. You take fewer blows with them at your back.
arc.grandline.swallow_crown.after.perciv: The wind's been quieter since you left. It misses you, I think. Don't tell it I said so.
arc.grandline.swallow_crown.after.kagero: Your stance is better. Your posture is still a disgrace.
arc.grandline.swallow_crown.after.isador: My guards stand straighter than they ever have. You did that.
The court sits every morning. Slowly, slowly, the scales come level. Thank you, Sir Knight.
arc.grandline.swallow_crown.after.townsf: They say the treasurer was skimming for years. Gold leaf in the margins! Can you imagine?
The road's guarded again — by the same lads who were robbing it! Honest work suits them. The shops are giving you the road price.
The court's been sitting for weeks. Everyone's very just and nobody can get to market. Still — it's right, isn't it?
The caravan's back and the grain's bought! Percival's been insufferably smug about the wind.
arc.grandline.ice_house.why: The ice ships that keep the South Blue's catch fresh have stopped coming. Captain Brinicle — thrown out of Master Kiko's sea-karate dojo — seized the Sorbet Kingdom's royal ice house and sells the ice back at ten times the price.
arc.grandline.ice_house.cast.mahina: 'Sunspot', the South Ember. The Saltfire King's old cook: nobody leaves her kitchen hungry.
arc.grandline.ice_house.cast.kiko: master of sea-karate on Karate Island. Teaches you to let the ocean punch for you.
arc.grandline.ice_house.cast.gelato: King of the Sorbet Kingdom. Very sincere about desserts.
arc.grandline.ice_house.cast.brinicle: 'the Ice Thief', a sea-karate dropout with a grudge and a warehouse full of stolen ice.
arc.grandline.decision.south_plan: when to take the ice house (talk to King Gelato)
arc.grandline.site.hinata_raiders: the pantry thieves' camp among Hinata's palms
arc.grandline.site.karate_ring: the challengers' ring on Karate Island
arc.grandline.site.sorbet_ice_house: the back gate of the royal ice house
quest.grandline.south_freezers.desc: Reach the Sorbet Kingdom and clear 5 of Brinicle's thieves from the ice road.
quest.grandline.south_choice.desc: Brinicle threatens to melt the royal ice house if anyone attacks. Talk to King Gelato and decide when to strike.
quest.grandline.south_storm.desc: Find Master Kiko on the ice road. You go in together.
quest.grandline.south_sneak.desc: Under the night frost, beat 3 of the crew watching the ice house's back gate.
quest.grandline.south_brinicle.desc: Defeat Brinicle Shimoyake in the royal ice house.
scene.grandline.ember_south_1.start.1: mahina|Eat first, talk later! Sit. SIT. ...There. Now, you've got that look. The sea is calling, isn't it?
scene.grandline.ember_south_1.start.2: mahina|I cooked for the Saltfire King for twelve years. Nobody left my galley hungry — not even him, and he tried.
scene.grandline.ember_south_1.start.3: mahina|But my pantry's empty. The ice ship from the Sorbet Kingdom didn't come, the fish spoiled, and last night thieves cleaned out what was left. Smoked fish, rice, my good pickles.
scene.grandline.ember_south_1.start.4: mahina|Get it back. And fight properly, or you'll get hurt and I'll have to feed you broth: land a blow, guard one, dodge one, show me a technique. Ask me for a practice bout first if you like. I'll go easy. I won't, actually.
scene.grandline.ember_south_1.talk.1: mahina|The thieves went into the palms. Hungry? Want a practice bout first? Both? Both is good.
scene.grandline.ember_south_1.end.1: mahina|There! You fight like you've eaten properly. That's half of it.
scene.grandline.ember_south_1.end.2: narrator|The thieves' sacks hold Mahina's pickles — and a crate stamped ROYAL ICE HOUSE, SORBET KINGDOM, sold on at ten times its price.
scene.grandline.ember_south_1.end.3: mahina|Stolen ice, sold back to the hungry. That's no way to treat a sea.
scene.grandline.ember_south_1.end.4: mahina|Before you go near whoever's doing that, go to Karate Island and let Kiko teach you to stand. Take my chart. Then see King Gelato — he'll be crying into a sorbet, I expect.
scene.grandline.ember_south_2.start.1: mahina|Karate Island is east. Take the chart, and this lunch, and this second lunch.
scene.grandline.ember_south_2.end.1: narrator|Karate Island: terraces of sand and stone, and on every terrace someone punching the sea.
scene.grandline.south_karate_cup.start.1: kiko|Sea-karate isn't about punching the ocean. It's about letting the ocean punch for you. Feet wider. WIDER. There.
scene.grandline.south_karate_cup.start.2: kiko|Beat my three challengers, then me. If you're still standing, we'll talk.
scene.grandline.south_karate_cup.end.1: kiko|...You let the ocean punch. Good. Take this scroll.
scene.grandline.south_karate_cup.end.2: kiko|You asked about the ice. I know who has it. Brinicle — my worst student. I threw him out for hitting a child in the ring. He swore he'd make the whole South Blue pay for it.
scene.grandline.south_karate_cup.end.3: kiko|He's at the Sorbet Kingdom's ice house. A master doesn't chase her failures. ...Usually.
scene.grandline.south_freezers.end.1: narrator|The ice road to the royal ice house is littered with Brinicle's men. Beyond it, the ice house sweats in the sun, its great doors chained.
scene.grandline.south_freezers.end.2: gelato|By royal decree, all visitors must — oh, you've beaten the thieves! Speak, speak, the crown is listening!
scene.grandline.south_freezers.end.3: gelato|That villain has my ice house. Every ice ship in the South Blue loads there. Without it, fish spoil from here to Hinata. And he says if anyone attacks, he'll open the doors and melt the lot out of spite!
scene.grandline.south_choice.talk.1: gelato|My councillors say wait for tonight. The night frost comes in hard off the glacier; under its cover we bring the ice out by the back gate before he knows. He'll still have his crew watching that gate.
scene.grandline.south_choice.talk.2: kiko|I say now. I've come this far. Brinicle is MY failure — I'll stand beside you and we'll go in through the front door. He'll melt half the stores before we reach him. Half.
scene.grandline.south_choice.talk.3: gelato|Half of the South Blue's summer! Oh, this is a terrible decree to make. You make it. I'll sign it in sorbet.
scene.grandline.choice.south_plan.storm: Storm it now, with Master Kiko. Brinicle doesn't get another night.
scene.grandline.choice.south_plan.frost: Wait for the night frost and get the ice out first.
scene.grandline.south_choice.end.storm.1: kiko|Then find me on the ice road. Feet wide. We go in together.
scene.grandline.south_choice.end.frost.1: gelato|The frost comes at moonrise. His crew watches the back gate — someone will have to make them stop watching.
scene.grandline.south_storm.end.1: kiko|Ready? The ocean's behind us. Let it punch.
scene.grandline.south_sneak.end.1: narrator|The back-gate crew goes down without a shout. Under the night frost, the ice comes out block by block on royal sledges.
scene.grandline.south_brinicle.start.1: brinicle|You want the ice? Come and get it. It's cold in here.
scene.grandline.south_brinicle.start.sto: brinicle|MASTER! You came yourself! Then watch this — watch me melt your precious summer!
scene.grandline.south_brinicle.start.fro: brinicle|Fine. Then I'll take it out of your hide.
scene.grandline.south_brinicle.end.1: narrator|Brinicle goes down on the wet floor of the ice house.
scene.grandline.south_brinicle.end.storm: narrator|Brinicle goes down on the wet floor of the ice house. Half the stores are a lake; the other half are saved.
kiko|He was my student. Now he's nobody's. ...You fought well. Come and train with me any time.
scene.grandline.south_brinicle.end.frost: narrator|Brinicle goes down in an empty ice house. Every block is already on its way to the harbour.
scene.grandline.south_sorbet_royal.end.1: gelato|The ice house is ours again! Take this Log Pose: the Twin Capes await, at the foot of Reverse Mountain.
scene.grandline.south_sorbet_royal.end.s: gelato|Half the ice! Half! Well — half a summer is better than none, and you brought down the villain. The crown is grateful. Mostly.
gelato|Take this Log Pose. Every great South Blue sailor ends up at the Twin Capes, at the foot of Reverse Mountain. By royal decree, go and be great.
scene.grandline.south_sorbet_royal.end.f: gelato|All of it! Every block! The ice ships are loading already! By royal decree, a reward — no, two rewards — no, THREE! The crown is BEING GENEROUS!
gelato|Take this Log Pose. The Twin Capes lie north-east, at the foot of Reverse Mountain. Go and be great.
recap.grandline.ember_south_1: Got Auntie Mahina's pantry back from the thieves while she taught you to fight.
recap.grandline.ember_south_2: Found a crate of stolen royal ice and sailed to Karate Island to learn from Master Kiko.
recap.grandline.south_karate_cup: Won the Sea-Karate Cup; Kiko named the ice thief — Brinicle, her worst student.
recap.grandline.south_freezers: Cleared the ice road; Brinicle holds the royal ice house and threatens to melt it all.
recap.grandline.south_choice.storm: Decided to storm the ice house at once, with Master Kiko.
recap.grandline.south_choice.frost: Decided to wait for the night frost and get the ice out first.
recap.grandline.south_storm: Kiko stood ready beside you on the ice road.
recap.grandline.south_sneak: Took the back gate under the night frost; the ice came out block by block.
recap.grandline.south_brinicle: Brought down Brinicle the Ice Thief.
recap.grandline.south_brinicle.storm: Brought down Brinicle with Master Kiko; half the ice melted.
recap.grandline.south_brinicle.frost: Brought down Brinicle in an empty ice house; every block was saved.
recap.grandline.south_sorbet_royal: Received King Gelato's thanks and a Log Pose for the Twin Capes.
arc.grandline.ice_house.bonus.frost: King Gelato pays you 3,000 Beli 'by royal decree', and the Sorbet Kingdom's shops give you 15% off from now on.
arc.grandline.ice_house.bonus.storm: Master Kiko gives you a second copy of her scroll — 'one for you, one for whoever you teach' — and Karate Island counts you as one of its own.
arc.grandline.ice_house.aid.storm: Kiko plants her feet beside you. 'Let the ocean punch.' Your blows land harder.
arc.grandline.ice_house.after.mahina: The ice ship came! Fresh fish, cold pickles — sit down, sit down, you've earned a third helping.
arc.grandline.ice_house.after.kiko.storm: You fought beside me against my own failure. That makes you my student, whether you like it or not.
arc.grandline.ice_house.after.kiko.frost: You were patient. Patience is the ocean's first technique. I may have to learn it myself.
arc.grandline.ice_house.after.gelato: The crown is listening! And the crown is grateful!
arc.grandline.ice_house.after.gelato.sto: Half a summer! Still, the crown is grateful. Have a sorbet. A half-sorbet.
arc.grandline.ice_house.after.gelato.fro: THE HERO OF THE FROST! By royal decree, you never pay full price in the Sorbet Kingdom again!
The ice ships are sailing again!
Every ice ship loaded on time! The king's ordered every shop to give you the frost price. That's a discount. He invented it.
Half the ice house melted, they say. Still — no more Ice Thief, and the ships are sailing.
The ice ship came back! Mahina's been feeding the whole village to celebrate. Again.
You and Master Kiko went in through the front door together! The whole island's talking about it.
They say you waited for the frost like a true master. Kiko's been unbearable about it.
